name: agent-board
description: A kanban board in Claude Code: cards run through planner, executor and reviewer agents, each in its own context, with an approval step after planning.

maxParallel.title: Cards running at once
maxParallel.description: How many cards may have an agent working at the same time.

planModel.title: Planner model
planModel.description: Model the planner agent uses (inherit = the session's model).

executeModel.title: Executor model
executeModel.description: Model the executor agent uses (inherit = the session's model).

reviewModel.title: Reviewer model
reviewModel.description: Model the reviewer agent uses (inherit = the session's model).

autoStart.title: Start planning new cards automatically
autoStart.description: Off: new cards wait in Backlog until you press Start.

pauseAtLimit.title: Pause new work at plan usage %
pauseAtLimit.description: Start no agent while the 5-hour or 7-day limit is at or above this. 0 turns the pause off.

webPort.title: Browser board port
webPort.description: The browser board is served at http://localhost:<port> while a session runs. 0 turns it off.

webHost.title: Browser board address
webHost.description: Where the browser board listens. 127.0.0.1 keeps it to this machine (WSL included); 0.0.0.0 opens it to your network.

worktrees.title: A git branch per card
worktrees.description: The executor and reviewer work in a git worktree of their own (branch board/card-N); you merge or discard it when the card is done. Off: they work directly in the project.

notify.title: Notify when a card needs you
notify.description: A desktop notification when a plan waits for approval, an agent stops, or a branch is ready to merge.

allowlist.title: Agents run safe commands without asking
allowlist.description: Each board agent runs its role's allowlisted commands (see hooks/allowlist.ts) without a permission prompt, and in auto mode without auto mode's check; the board also approves starting its own agents. Anything else still asks. Off by default.
